content:
The test suite failed because it attempted to use an unsupported '--recalculate' flag with the 'ssconvert' command.
The verifier failed with a subprocess.CalledProcessError during the execution of 'test_outputs.py'. The error message explicitly states: "stderr = b'Unknown option --recalculate\nRun \'ssconvert --help\' to see a full list of available command line options.\n'". This occurred within the '_recalculate_with_ssconvert' function while trying to process '/root/output/result.xlsx'. Avoid using the '--recalculate' flag in this environment's version of ssconvert.
